text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm so bored of this!!
I don't wanna do anything that doesn't go my way!
choice_data_list: So you're giving up on becoming a witch too?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...!!
No, I don't want that!
I'm gonna be a witch! I'll never give up!!
choice_data_list: Then we'll just have to win the race.
Then we'll just have to win the race.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...T-That's right! Winning is everything!
Otherwise it's boring,
and besides, I'll never become a witch like this!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Next time, I definitely, definitely won't lose!
choice_data_list: Well then, let's make sure to train properly.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Next time, I definitely, definitely won't lose!
choice_data_list: Well then, let's make sure to train properly.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, of course I will!
I'm going to concoct the most extraordinary magic to make sure we win!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing, familiar?!
Hurry up and help me out!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Mumu... Why do we have to train...
Can't we just poof it done with magic!?
choice_data_list: It's training to master the magic of victory.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... If you're talking it up that much,
you must have a special menu planned out, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fine. Guess I've got no choice, I'll test it out.
Just know that if I don't win with this, I won't forgive you!
